old_caption: The video opens with a wide shot of an expansive, dark, and overcast sky above a flat, open landscape. In the foreground, a single large, dark object rests on the ground. As the scene progresses, this object begins to emit a bright, fiery glow from its center. The glow intensifies, and the object starts to explode, sending billows of smoke and flames into the air. The explosion is powerful, with the flames and smoke expanding outward, creating a dramatic visual effect against the dark backdrop. The smoke rises high, swirling and billowing, while the flames continue to burn brightly, illuminating the surrounding area. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, capturing the full scope of the explosion and its aftermath. The landscape remains static, with no other significant movement or changes occurring in the background.

caption: Under a dim overcast sky, a flat field bordered by bare trees holds a large explosion cloud already churning at the frame's center. Dark finger-like plumes rise from a dense billowing mass of pale gray-white vapor spreading low along the ground. A small dark fragment drifts in the upper-right sky, rising toward the right edge while the camera stays fixed. Within the cloud, faint orange flecks of combustion appear and gather into a glowing core. The fire brightens and swells, its warm light illuminating the smoke from within. Bright combustion spreads across the central and right portions, turning the plumes into a fiery column. The dark smoke keeps billowing upward while the pale base churns near the ground. The fireball still grows at the last frame, its glow intensifying against the gray backdrop.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.
You receive the original WISA caption's stylistic profile, without its possibly wrong facts.

and retain supported scene details while clearly describing the main visible process. Do not
replace it with a short keyword prompt, physics explanation, checklist or a generic summary.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
